binding_constraint: Costs are not the binding constraint: the median pair needs only |z| >= 0.08 to clear 24bps, because these spreads are wide. What fails is stationarity — a wide spread that does not revert is divergence risk, not edge
verdict: 66 pair(s) tested. 1 reached p <= 0.05 naively, against 3.3 expected by chance alone at that level. 0 survive Benjamini-Hochberg at q=0.05 and 0 survive Bonferroni (p <= 0.00076). None is tradeable: after a four-leg round trip of 24bps, no surviving pair has both a stationary out-of-sample spread and a history of reaching the entry that pays for it. Reported as no opportunity rather than as the best of a bad list. Costs are not the binding constraint: the median pair needs only |z| >= 0.08 to clear 24bps, because these spreads are wide. What fails is stationarity — a wide spread that does not revert is divergence risk, not edge
